title: tabernaemontana africana
intro: Tabernaemontana africana, commonly known as Yellow Balloon, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against various diseases and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana africana include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcer properties, making it a traditional remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids such as voacangine, voacristine, and voacamine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
